brief_title: Creator explains why one habit trick beat their whole feed
hook_spoken: This habit trick got two million views and here is why.

structure.beat: Creator states the view count and promises the reason behind it
Names the mistake most people make with habit streaks
Holds up the phone and walks through the fix inside the app
Closes by telling viewers to follow for the next breakdown

product_or_topic_shown: A habit tracking app, held up to the camera mid explanation
why_it_worked: the claim is specific enough to check, so viewers stay for the reason instead of the advice, and the comments ask what the app is and whether it runs on Android
adaptation_for_product: open with a real Sprout retention number and explain the day four drop off that the streak screen fixes
avoid: The talking head who says consistency is key without ever showing a screen
